objective: Proof with machine check: in the proved class within five places, dead knots allowed, blocks have 2 to 5 points and meet in at most one; each live knot lies in blocks whose sizes sum to at most five; chains start only at lone points and at ends of two-point blocks; tree pieces have dimension equal to their chain ends; one-cycle pieces are constant or exponential at the root of W(1/x) = 1 for a product W; pieces with two or more cycles grow exponentially.
title: The map within five places, dead knots included
